description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2016 World Championships, an unexpected Mega Audino-EX deck that was the talk of the event. Its Magical Symphony attack can Knock Out an Active Shaymin-EX and a smaller Benched Pokémon such as Joltik or Combee in one hit, which made it strong against the most popular decks. The 2016 World Championships were held at the San Francisco Marriott Marquis in San Francisco, California, from 19 to 21 August 2016.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2016 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
